title: Peruvian Ham Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful twist on traditional fritters, featuring Peruvian ham as the main ingredient. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, combine Peruvian ham, yeasty, crunchy, and solo.
Add dinner to the mixture and stir well.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
